hasDefinedTerm.name: APN
hasDefinedTerm.description: Access Point Name. The setting that tells your device how to reach a mobile-data network. Travel eSIMs normally configure it for you, so you rarely need to change it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: eSIM
hasDefinedTerm.description: Embedded SIM. A SIM built into your device as software rather than a plastic card. You add a plan by downloading a profile, so there's nothing to insert or swap.

hasDefinedTerm.name: EID
hasDefinedTerm.description: Embedded Identifier. The permanent serial number of the eSIM chip inside your device. Dial *#06#, and if an EID appears your device can use an eSIM.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ICCID
hasDefinedTerm.description: Integrated Circuit Card Identifier. The unique ID of a single SIM profile â physical or eSIM â that tells the network which plan is installed on your device.

hasDefinedTerm.name: IMEI
hasDefinedTerm.description: International Mobile Equipment Identity. A unique number that identifies your phone itself, separate from any SIM. Dial *#06# to see it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: LTE
hasDefinedTerm.description: Long-Term Evolution. The technical name for 4G mobile data â the fast, widely available standard most travel eSIMs use for browsing, maps, and streaming.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MNO
hasDefinedTerm.description: Mobile Network Operator. A company that owns the towers and radio network in a country. Your travel eSIM connects through these local operators abroad.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MVNO
hasDefinedTerm.description: Mobile Virtual Network Operator. A mobile brand that sells service without owning towers, renting capacity from an operator instead. Many eSIM providers work this way.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Roaming
hasDefinedTerm.description: Using a network other than your home carrier's while you travel. A travel eSIM gives you local data directly, so you skip your home carrier's roaming charges.

hasDefinedTerm.name: VPN
hasDefinedTerm.description: Virtual Private Network. A tool that encrypts your connection and hides your location, adding privacy on public Wi-Fi and mobile data while you're away.

hasDefinedTerm.name: VoLTE
hasDefinedTerm.description: Voice over LTE. A way to place calls over a 4G network instead of older voice channels, giving clearer audio and quicker connections where it's supported.
